builder.validationOk: Draft is valid and ready to publish ✓
builder.publishConfirm: This connector will immediately become visible to every tenant in the marketplace. Continue?

versions.createDraftVersionConfirm: This connector will move back to Draft so you can work on the next version — the current published version and every connection pinned to it are completely unaffected.

builder.draftBanner: You are editing a draft of the next version — the currently published version (v{version}) keeps serving every new connection completely unaffected.
builder.discardDraftConfirm: Every edit in this draft will be permanently deleted. The currently published version is never affected.

bulk.samePicked: Pick two different versions to preview.
bulk.capabilityWarning: May break a tool/agent assignment relying on this capability — unchecked by default
bulk.migrateConfirm: Compatibility will be checked and a real health check run on each of the {count} selected connections before anything changes — only the ones that actually pass will be migrated.
bulk.rollbackConfirm: Only rolls back the connections this specific operation actually migrated, each through the same safety checks.

bulkReprocess.reprocessConfirm: Real mapping and dispatch will be re-run for each of the {count} selected events against their exact original stored payload — no event that already processed successfully will ever be re-sent.

customConnectors.approveConfirm: "{name}" will become published for this tenant only, never for any other tenant.
customConnectors.rejectConfirm: This connector stays in Draft and will not be published.
